ex.s: Damages of scentscapes can be artificially repaired.
ex.t: 缺失植物的气味在大气中被保存下来。

ex.s: Given the astonishing potential of AI to transform our lives, we all need to take action to deal with our AI-powered future, and this is where AI by Design: A Plan for Living with Artificial Intelligence comes in.
ex.t: 鉴于AI改变我们生活的惊人潜力，我们都需要采取行动来应对这个由AI驱动的未来，而这正是《AI by Design：与人工智能共处之计》一书的用武之地。

ex.s: As we soon come to learn from AI by Design AI is already super-smart and will become more capable, moving from the current generation of “narrow-AI” to Artificial General Intelligence.
ex.t: 正如我们很快就能从《设计人工智能》中了解到的那样，人工智能已经超级聪明，并且将变得更强大，从当前的“狭义人工智能”发展到通用人工智能。

ex.s: From there, Campbell says, will come Artificial Dominant Intelligence.
ex.t: 坎贝尔说，在那之后将会出现超级主导智能。

ex.s: She says it is essential that we keep control of artificial intelligence, or risk being sidelined and perhaps even worse.
ex.t: 她说，我们必须始终掌控人工智能，否则就有被边缘化甚至更糟的风险。

ex.s: And that’s why, however astonishing Project Debater may seem, the tradition that began with Socrates and Confucius will not end with artificial intelligence.
ex.t: 正因如此，无论Project Debater多么惊人，始于苏格拉底和孔子的传统不会随人工智能终结。

ex.s: Artificial intelligence ensures humans a bright future.
ex.t: 人工智能确保人类拥有光明未来。

ex.s: The field of artificial life-called ALife for short — is the systematic attempt to spell out life’s fundamental principles.
ex.t: 人工生命领域——简称ALife——是系统性地阐明生命基本原理的尝试。

ex.s: So far no one has convincingly made artificial life.
ex.t: 迄今为止，还没有人令人信服地创造出人工生命。

ex.s: As much as many ALifers hate emphasizing their research’s applications, the attempts to create artificial life could have practical payoffs.
ex.t: 尽管许多ALife研究者不喜欢强调他们研究的实际应用，但创造人工生命的尝试可能会有实际的回报。

ex.s: But using machine learning and artificial intelligence, some scientists propose that human diets consist of at least 26,000 biochemicals—and that the vast majority are not known.This shows that we have some way to travel before achieving the first objective of systems t hinking - which,in this example, is to identify more constituent parts of the nutrition system.
ex.t: 但利用机器学习和人工智能,一些科学家提出人类的饮食至少包括26,000个生化物质 — — 而绝大多数是未知的。 这表明,我们在实现“吸食系统”这一首要目标之前有某种途径可以旅行 — — 在这个例子中,这是为了确定营养系统中更多的组成部分。

ex.s: Some of today's AI pioneers want to move on from today's world of “weak” or “narrow” AI, to create “strong” or “full” AI, or what is often called artificial general intelligence（A GI）.
ex.t: 当今一些人工智能先驱想要摆脱“弱”或“窄”人工智能的当下，去创造“强”或“全”人工智能，即常被称为通用人工智能（AGI）的东西。

ex.t: 7．（1分）我们可以观察到人工智能已经在许多方面对我们生活产生了________。（  ）

ex.s: Otherwise, the recreation of traditions would be artificial and empty, he said.
ex.t: 这对他来说完全足够了。

ex.t: （你可以在上面的视频中看到它是如何运作的。）红、白、黑相间的贝壳条都来自兰加兰加泻湖，当地人很久以前就在那里建造人工岛以躲避岛上的食人族。

ex.s: The real problem relates to the possibility that artificial intelligence(AI) may become extremely good at achieving something other than what we really want.
ex.t: 真正的问题与这样一种可能性有关：人工智能（AI）可能变得极其擅长实现某些并非我们真正想要的东西。

ex.s: “Some people ask me, ‘So what’s the worth of artificial life?’ Do you ever think, ‘What is the worth of your grandmother?’”
ex.t: "有人问我，'那人工生命有什么价值？'你有没有想过，'你祖母的价值是什么？'"

ex.s: What will remain of us when artificial intelligence takes over will be our creativity, and it is our creative spirit, our visionary sense of freshness,that has been our strength for centuries."
ex.t: “当人工智能接管一切后，留给我们的将是创造力，而正是我们的创造精神、我们对新鲜事物的远见，几个世纪以来一直是我们的力量所在。”

ex.s: Milestones in Artificial Intelligence (AI) 1950 Mathematician and logician, Alan Turing devised the Turing Test, a test on the ability of machines to show human-like intelligence.
ex.t: 1950年人工智能（ AI ）的里程碑数学家和逻辑学家艾伦·图灵（ Alan Turing ）设计了图灵测试（ Turing Test ） ，这是对机器展示类似人类智能的能力的测试。

ex.s: In the words of Professor Stephen Hawking, Artificial Intelligence will be “either the best, or the worst thing, ever to happen to humanity”.
ex.t: 用斯蒂芬·霍金教授的话说，人工智能将是"要么是最好的，要么是最坏的，有史以来发生在人类身上的事情"。

ex.s: Of course, it could be very useful to have a more advanced form of AI — a truly independent form of artificial intelligence, capable of exercising its own judgement, could help us solve many of the world’s problems.
ex.t: 例如，如果你想说"别紧张"，你可能会用"保持冷静，carry on"这个短语。

ex.s: UNIT 5 WORKING THE LAND CHEMICAL VERSUS ORGANIC FARMING Chemical pesticides and artificial fertilisers have been in widespread use in farming since the middle of the 20th century.
ex.t: 第五单元 耕耘土地 化学农业与有机农业 自20世纪中叶以来，化学杀虫剂和人工肥料在农业中得到了广泛使用。
